items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Honey, I can’t think of what you’re talking about, about Thad Cochran.

ctx.x: Honey, I can’t think of what you’re talking about, about Thad Cochran.
She got in touch with a Congressman... I don’t know what that was about. She wrote a column for the newspaper, and he took exception to something that she wrote, and she called him about it.
